name: pack_sprite_control_words
description: Computes the two sprite control words from an x and y position, offsetting the vertical start by 44 and the horizontal start by 128, then stores them as a pair in the output buffer. The second word encodes the vertical stop bit and the low horizontal bit.

name: poll_command_queue_byte
description: Runs a queued list of 5-word command records: entries of type 1 program a sprite-style table, type 2 recurses into the same routine, type 3 writes a 32-bit value into a table slot, and type 4 clears an indirect pointer. When the queue is finished it returns the next byte of a byte stream.

name: run_command_queue_step
description: Processes the same 5-word command records as its neighbours (table writes, recursion for nested entries, indirect clears) and returns a byte from the stream once the queue is exhausted. It serves as a separate entry into the shared command interpreter.

name: drain_command_queue
description: Processes queued command records (table writes, nested recursion, indirect clears) until a terminator is reached, then clears the queue's pending-callback slot. It has no return value.

name: blit_entries_from_list
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then for each entry in a list programs the blitter control, mask, pointer and size registers from a position and a size field. It finishes by clearing the pending-work flag and a reset byte.

name: build_blit_jobs_for_entries
description: Walks an 11-word record list and, for each record whose horizontal extent is narrow, computes the bit-shift and mask values and writes a blitter job into the job table. Wider records get a different job layout, and the routine ends by marking the job queue as empty.

name: advance_object_list_positions
description: Walks a null-terminated list of object records, updating each object's position and frame values from a lookup table and a timing counter. It writes the result into the custom-chip work registers and returns early while a countdown is above its threshold.

name: dispatch_table_entries
description: Walks a zero-terminated table of 8-byte records, copies each record's address and value into fixed RAM cells, and calls an external routine for each one before the final call.

name: dispatch_table_with_port_poll
description: Reads an input-port register and merges a set of constants into two values, then walks a zero-terminated table and calls an external routine for each record. The final call ends the sequence.

name: copy_pair_and_chain
description: Copies the first two 32-bit values of a block into a shared cell pair, then passes the address that follows them to an external routine. The routine is a six-instruction stub.

name: swap_bitplane_buffers_set_pointers
description: Alternates a state flag between two buffer addresses and, when the active flag is set, fills 16 colour entries with the brightest value. It then derives four consecutive bitplane pointers from the chosen buffer, spaced 32000 bytes apart, and stores them.

name: run_four_update_steps
description: Calls four external routines one after another and returns. It only sequences those calls and has no data of its own.

name: write_row_to_five_planes
description: Waits for the blitter, then for each four-word record of a terminated table computes a screen address from a row and column and writes the same value to five bitplane offsets spaced 8000 bytes apart. A terminator byte marks the end of the table.

name: step_timed_entry_list
description: Walks an active list of five-word entries, decrementing each counter; an entry whose counter has run out is refilled from a pool, while the others are copied to an output list. The output list is closed with a sentinel value.

name: draw_clipped_sprite_list
description: Walks sprite entries and clips each one against the 320 by 200 screen area in both directions. It programs the blitter for the visible part, updates the bitplane pointers, and marks the list finished with a sentinel when it ends.

name: emit_sprite_rows_to_planes
description: Waits for the blitter, then walks a list of sprite records and, for each one within the visible height, programs the blitter for four bitplane rows spaced 8000 bytes apart, using the record's shift value. A sentinel ends the list.

name: update_active_slot_counters
description: Checks a mode value and, for each of two slots that the mode allows, increments a counter once a threshold is reached, reads the next value from a lookup table, and calls routines to refresh the slot. Each slot's update ends with an optional extra call.

name: draw_packed_digit_glyphs
description: Splits a packed 32-bit value into its 4-bit digits from the most significant end, skipping leading zeros, and writes each digit's glyph bytes into seven rows of the output spaced 40 bytes apart.

name: copy_four_sixteen_word_rows
description: Selects one of four source blocks by index, after a long busy-wait when the index is out of range, and copies sixteen words per row for four rows into the destination with a row stride of 1120 bytes.

name: copy_block_rows_set_background
description: Performs the same busy-wait and four-row, sixteen-word block copy as its neighbour, but takes the source block index from a stack argument. The register list also marks the background colour register, but the shown code only copies the block.

name: run_threshold_actions_for_slots
description: For each of two slots, runs an external routine when the slot is not excluded by the mode and its counter is above zero, and again when the counter is above four. The mode decides which slot is skipped.

name: draw_two_digit_number
description: Caps a value at 99, then writes its tens digit only when it is non-zero, followed by its units digit, as glyph bytes into seven rows spaced 40 bytes apart.

name: copy_tiled_word_block
description: Copies up to four groups of four rows of sixteen words each from a source block into a destination, advancing the destination by 20 bytes per word group and by 820 bytes per row group.

name: queue_stage_draw_request
description: When its active flag is set, advances a stage counter and appends a two-long draw request to a queue, choosing one of two shared addresses by stage. Once the stage passes its limit it clears the active flag.

name: clear_flag_bit_then_delay
description: Clears one selected bit in a byte at a computed address, then spins in a countdown loop whose length depends on the input value before returning.

name: tick_audio_sequencer
description: Advances a three-step frame counter. On the last step it resets the audio state and calls four channel routines; every 64 ticks it loads the next set of channel pointers from a sequence table, and on other steps it updates the active channels.

name: dispatch_channel_command
description: Decodes the low nibble of a command byte: one case jumps through a dispatch table, two cases adjust a 16-bit value and clamp it to 113 or 856, one case stores a byte, and the remaining cases return without effect.

name: add_nibble_clamped_upper
description: Adds a 4-bit parameter to a 16-bit value, clamps the sum at 856, and stores the result in two places.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work, so it is an empty slot in the dispatch table.

name: stub_return_only_wrapper
description: Returns immediately without doing any work; the decompiler shows no effect for this entry.

name: store_channel_parameter_byte
description: Copies the parameter byte of a command into a single byte field of the channel record.

name: dispatch_audio_state_handler
description: Calls a handler selected by an indirect jump indexed by an audio state counter. The jump table could not be recovered from the code shown, so the target handler is not identified.

name: clear_audio_channel_pending_flags
description: Clears the pending flag of each of four audio channels, setting the output value to one whenever a flag was set, and masks a control value with a constant.

name: advance_audio_channel_note
description: Decrements a channel's duration counter. When it expires, reads the next note and command bytes from the channel's stream, loads the sample pointer and length from a table, and runs the shared command dispatch; otherwise it clears the channel's output words.

name: unpack_bitstream_to_buffer
description: Decodes a packed bit stream into bytes, copying repeated runs from earlier output and reading its counts from a table. The register list also marks the DMA control register, but the shown code only decodes data.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes as an unimplemented instruction and does no real work, so the output is bad data rather than behaviour.

name: set_colour_dma_interrupt_state
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The register list shows writes to the background colour, DMA control and interrupt enable registers, plus one call to another routine; the exact values are not recovered.

name: poll_state_flags_loop
description: A long polling loop that reads a state word, tests its bits to dispatch several routines and a countdown, and repeats until a terminating state is reached. It references the text 'Ice!'.

name: transform_words_if_marker_matches
description: Compares a 32-bit value with the ASCII text 'Ice!' and, if it matches, runs 4000 passes over groups of four words, shifting each with carry propagation and storing the results back.

name: accumulate_32bit_from_bytes
description: Reads four consecutive bytes from the address register and concatenates them into one 32-bit result. The shown code matches the description of the same routine in another game.

name: unpack_backward_lz_stream
description: Decodes a packed stream from its end, reading length and distance codes and copying earlier output backward into the destination. It stops when the destination start is reached.

name: short_delay_loop
description: Runs a short countdown loop with a fixed count and returns; it is a brief pause routine with no other effect.

name: check_flags_no_effect
description: Tests a sign bit and a low flag bit of its inputs and returns. Both branches are empty, so the routine changes no state.

name: read_bits_from_word_stream
description: Shifts bits out of a bit buffer one at a time. When the buffer empties, it loads the next word from the input stream, so the caller receives a requested number of bits.

name: run_main_frame_loop
description: Sets the interrupt control register, then loops once per frame: it reads the raster position and the fire-button port, updates a state word from its bits, and calls twelve routines to handle each state. Its flag-driven branches decide which of those routines run.

name: run_frame_update_subsystems
description: Sets a timing value, then calls a series of subsystem routines gated by status bits. When a particular state bit is set it resets the state counters and marks a sub-state.

name: run_frame_update_variant
description: Follows the same sequence as its neighbour: sets a timing value, calls subsystem routines gated by status bits, and resets state counters when the state bit is set. It calls a different set of subsystem routines.

name: advance_sequence_state_machine
description: Steps a multi-bit state word through its states according to status bits and a counter, wrapping around at the limits. At each step it calls routines that refresh the affected subsystem and writes a table index.

name: init_descriptor_table_entries
description: Stores a set of constant words and two values scaled from an index into a small descriptor table in RAM, then clears one flag bit.

name: sort_records_by_key_word
description: Bubble-sorts five groups of ten-byte records by a 16-bit key, swapping out-of-order entries in five passes.

name: advance_alt_state_machine
description: Steps a state word through its values in the same way as its neighbouring routine, using different state limits and calling a different set of subsystem routines.

name: init_second_descriptor_table_entries
description: Stores a set of constant words and two index-scaled values into a second descriptor table in RAM, then clears one flag bit. It is the same pattern as its neighbour with different constants.

name: read_cia_flag_and_clear
description: When a CIA interrupt flag bit is set, reads the complemented value of a CIA data register, waits a short countdown, and clears the flag bit. It then stores a constant into a global. The register list also marks the fire-button port.

name: init_three_state_values
description: Calls three routines in sequence, then clears one global, sets a second to 1, and sets a third to 200.

name: init_three_state_values_alt
description: Makes the same three calls and sets the same three globals as its neighbouring routine.

name: run_key_selection_loop
description: Initialises a list of table entries, then loops once per frame calling routines for each state flag. It branches on the key codes Q, U and T: Q returns, U restarts with new values, and T halts in a wait loop.

name: copy_seven_words_to_table
description: Copies seven consecutive 16-bit words from a source block into a fixed table of seven slots.

name: update_status_flags_from_checks
description: Tests two status bits, calls routines to refresh them when needed, and sets follow-up flag bits depending on the results.

name: reset_slot_table_state
description: Clears two counters and sets timing values, then resets eight four-byte slots to a fixed value. Before each reset it copies one byte from each slot into a backup area.

name: update_slot_streams_per_frame
description: Once per frame, decrements a timer and advances a stream of two-bit deltas for four slots, updating each slot's position and counter. It also calls a handler from a table on a fixed schedule.

name: init_display_state_block
description: Sets display state flags, calls a set of routines, and clears several counters. It then copies seven words from a source block into a fixed table.

name: advance_character_stream
description: Reads the next byte from a string table and stores it into two shared cells, setting a counter to 14. When the string ends it clears the active flag; otherwise it clears the cells and counts down.

name: init_and_update_grid_rows
description: Sets a timing value of 480 and copies a set of position words into two table pairs. It then runs nested loops that call routines to update the grid rows, followed by four more calls.

name: write_copper_pointer_pair
description: Writes a pair of 16-bit words encoding a register and a value into a list, then stores a 32-bit address split into high and low words in the pointer table.

name: set_base_pointer_from_index
description: Computes a table address from an index scaled by 128 plus a fixed offset, stores it with a second value, and calls a routine to use it.

name: prepare_four_digit_display_slots
description: Splits a value into thousands, hundreds, tens and units, looks up a pair of image pointers for each digit from two tables, stores them with horizontal offsets, and then calls a routine six times.

name: prepare_two_digit_display_slots
description: Splits a value into tens and units. When the tens digit is non-zero it sets its image pointers and calls a routine, then it sets the units pointers and calls the routine again.

name: tick_timer_set_flag
description: Decrements a countdown. When it reaches zero it clears one flag bit and sets another.

name: tick_countdown_set_high_flags
description: Decrements a countdown. When it reaches zero it sets two high flag bits.

name: clear_eight_table_longs
description: Clears eight consecutive 32-bit slots of a table to zero.

name: run_digit_counter_loop
description: Loops once per frame and updates a three-digit counter whose digits wrap at ten, six and ten. Each change refreshes the digit pointers and calls routines, and the loop exits when a state bit is set.

name: copy_sixteen_words_into_table
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from a source block into a table with a four-byte spacing between entries.

name: copy_eight_longs_to_table
description: Copies eight consecutive 32-bit values from a source block into eight fixed cells.

name: set_state_and_run_handler
description: Calls a routine and two others, sets a state byte to a fixed value, and calls one more routine when the state byte already held that value.

name: init_state_then_run_routines
description: Calls a routine and two others, sets a state byte to a fixed value, and then calls one more routine. It is the same sequence as its neighbour with a different call order.

name: clear_seven_state_slots
description: Clears a global and six related state slots to zero.

name: clear_seven_state_slots_alt
description: Clears the same kind of seven state slots as its neighbour, using a different set of addresses.

name: reset_buffer_and_mode_state
description: Clears 132 consecutive 32-bit words of a buffer, then sets several mode bits and resets counters to zero or to fixed values.

name: reset_second_buffer_mode_state
description: Clears 116 consecutive 32-bit words of a second buffer, then resets a set of mode bits and counters to fixed values.

name: set_two_digit_display_state
description: Sets flag bits and calls two routines, looks up image pointers for the tens and units digits of a value from a table, calls a routine twice, and sets a state byte.

name: find_free_slot_and_mark
description: Scans a table of 16-bit entries from the top down, skipping entries above a threshold, and stores a marker value into the first slot that is free.

name: find_free_slot_mark_entry
description: Performs the same free-slot scan and marker store as its neighbour, entered at a separate address.

name: find_free_slot_then_call
description: Scans for a free slot in the same way as its neighbours and then calls one routine before returning.

name: set_counter_two_digit_slots
description: Sets a flag, calls routines, looks up image pointers for the tens and units digits of a stored counter, calls routines to draw them, and sets a state byte.

name: build_and_draw_entry_table
description: Loads a record from a table and copies its values into a working table, clears 22 entries, then loops over the working table calling routines to draw each active entry.

name: build_draw_entry_table_alt
description: Follows the same pattern as its neighbour with different constants: loads a record, copies its values, clears 22 entries and draws each active entry.

name: draw_two_digit_counter
description: Caps a counter at 99, looks up tens image pointers when the tens digit is non-zero, looks up the units pointers, calls routines to draw them, and stores two fixed pointer values.

name: draw_two_digit_counter_alt
description: Caps a counter at 99 and draws either only the units digit, when the tens digit is zero, or both digits. It then calls routines and stores two fixed pointer values.

name: setup_pointer_table_then_wait
description: Stores four pointer and count pairs into a table, sets a list pointer, waits until a flag reads as minus one, then stores the address of that flag cell and a fixed value.

name: setup_pointer_table_wait_alt
description: Performs the same table setup and flag wait as its neighbour, entered at a separate address.

name: setup_pointer_table_wait_two
description: Performs the same table setup and flag wait as its neighbours, entered at another address.

name: setup_pointer_table_wait_three
description: Performs the same table setup and flag wait as its neighbours, entered at another address.

name: setup_pointer_table_wait_four
description: Performs the same table setup and flag wait as its neighbours, entered at another address. It also checks a count against a value before continuing.

name: wait_frame_store_flag_address
description: Waits until a flag reads as minus one, then stores the address of that flag cell and a fixed value. The register list also marks the copper pointer and DMA control registers, but the shown code only waits and stores.

name: wait_frame_setup_pointer_pairs
description: Waits until the same flag reads as minus one, stores a fixed value, then writes four pointer and count pairs into the table.

name: finish_frame_poll_until_zero
description: Calls drawing routines when the flags allow it, clears one flag bit and calls another routine. When a second flag bit is set, it repeatedly calls a routine until that routine returns zero.

name: shift_entry_list_per_frame
description: Calls one routine and, when a flag bit is set, repeatedly calls another routine while copying three-long records back one slot at a time until that routine returns zero.

name: process_pair_table_advance_step
description: Calls routines conditionally. When one flag bit is set it walks a zero-terminated table of pairs, calling a routine for each. When another bit is set it polls a routine until it returns zero, then advances a step counter that wraps at 12.

name: finish_frame_and_poll_alt
description: Calls drawing routines when the flags allow, clears one flag bit, calls another routine, and polls a routine until it returns zero when a flag bit is set. It is the same pattern as its neighbour with different calls.

name: shift_entry_list_back_alt
description: Calls a routine when a flag bit is clear, then copies three-long records backwards while a routine returns a non-zero value and a flag bit is set. It mirrors its neighbour's record shift with a different condition.

name: process_pair_table_step_alt
description: Follows the same pattern as its neighbour: walks a zero-terminated pair table when one flag bit is set, polls a routine when another bit is set, and advances a step counter that wraps at 12.

name: select_next_state_handler
description: Chooses a new state from the status bits, then walks a table of handler pointers until it finds a non-empty entry. It calls that handler when it differs from the current one; the jump table could not be fully recovered.

name: call_changed_state_handler
description: Walks a table of handler pointers from the current position until it finds a non-empty entry, then calls it when it differs from the current handler. The jump table could not be fully recovered.

name: select_next_state_handler_alt
description: Selects a handler from the status bits and the handler table, as its neighbour does, but tracks the current handler in a different cell. It calls the handler only when it differs; the jump table could not be fully recovered.

name: call_changed_state_handler_alt
description: Selects a handler with the same table walk as its neighbours, then calls it only when it differs from the cell it last used. The jump table could not be fully recovered.

name: store_sprite_state_from_routine
description: Calls a routine that returns a pair of words, stores its parts with a value from a table into state cells, and adjusts the second word by two when it equals 34 while decrementing the first.

name: store_sprite_state_indexed
description: Performs the same state store as its neighbour, but takes its values from a table indexed by a register offset.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Returns immediately with no work, so it is an empty entry.

name: setup_blitter_masks_and_modulos
description: Computes the blitter first-word mask, shift and modulo values from a record's position and size, writes the blitter control and modulo registers, and calls routines to start the operation.

name: write_blitter_pointers_and_size
description: Stores five values into the blitter's four pointer registers and its size register.

name: compute_blitter_shift_control
description: Computes a shifted position and a control word pair from its inputs, returning them for use in the blitter setup.

name: stub_empty_return_routine_alt
description: Returns immediately with no work, so it is an empty entry.

name: setup_blitter_copy_with_masks
description: Writes the blitter mask, control and modulo registers from a record, sets the source and destination pointers with an offset of 24000 bytes (three bitplanes), and calls routines to set the size.

name: write_blitter_pointers_size_alt
description: Stores pointer and size values from a record into the blitter pointer registers and size register, as its neighbour does.

name: setup_blitter_masks_and_offset
description: Writes the blitter first-word mask and modulo registers from a record, computes two pointers offset by 24000 bytes, and calls routines to finish the setup.

name: write_blitter_pointer_and_size
description: Writes two values and a size word from a record into the blitter pointer and size registers.

name: set_blitter_control_and_size
description: Writes blitter control, mask, modulo, pointer and size registers from fixed values and a pointer argument, setting up a single-plane operation.

name: start_blitter_and_wait
description: Sets the blitter mask and control registers, writes a pointer offset by 8000 bytes (one bitplane), starts the blit, and waits until the blitter is idle.

name: start_blit_and_wait_idle
description: Writes the destination pointer and size word to start a blit, then waits until the blitter reports idle.

name: run_blit_sequence_and_wait
description: Chooses a count from a counter, writes a series of blitter control values with a shared pointer, then starts the blit and waits until the blitter is idle.

name: start_blit_offset_and_wait
description: Calls two routines and a third, writes a destination pointer offset by 8000 bytes (one bitplane), then waits until the blitter is idle.

name: start_blit_pointer_and_wait
description: Writes a destination pointer and a size value to the blitter, then waits until it reports idle.

name: start_fixed_blit_and_wait
description: Writes fixed control, mask and size values with a fixed destination pointer, then waits until the blitter is idle.

name: run_pending_flag_handlers
description: Calls one routine when the first flag reads zero and another when the second flag reads zero.

name: countdown_and_copy_sixteen_words
description: Decrements a countdown and, when it reaches its reset point, copies sixteen words within the same block, skipping every other word, and calls a routine.

name: decay_nibble_fields_per_step
description: On every second countdown step, reduces each 4-bit field of sixteen words by an amount that depends on the field's bit position. After sixteen steps it resets the counter and sets two flags.

name: decay_nibble_fields_with_step
description: Reduces each 4-bit field of sixteen words by a step passed in a register. After sixteen calls it resets the counter and sets two flags.

name: store_value_enable_interrupt_bits
description: Stores an argument, calls two routines, then writes a fixed value to the interrupt enable register.

name: stop_audio_channels
description: Calls a helper that turns off the four audio channels and clears their DMA enable bits, then returns.

name: poll_joystick_and_mouse_ports
description: Reads the joystick and mouse port registers and the interrupt request register, tracks button and direction state with countdown timers, and updates a state word and the saved values for the frame.

name: map_input_bits_to_flags
description: Maps the direction and button bits of an input word to status flags, and records the previous value so that a change to zero can be detected.

name: map_input_bits_flags_alt
description: Sets status flags from the bits of an input word, using the same mapping as its neighbour but without the change detection.

name: latch_fire_button_state
description: When a status bit is clear, sets a latched flag pair if it is not already set. When the bit is set, it clears the latch.

name: find_next_larger_table_entry
description: Scans a table of up to 128 bytes for the next entry larger than the previous one. When the table is exhausted, it clears four state cells and loads a value from the table; the audio volume registers are also marked by this routine.

name: advance_three_step_frame_cycle
description: Advances a three-step counter. On the third step it waits a short countdown, updates a status word, clears two request flags, and advances a row offset that wraps at 1024 and a segment counter. On the other steps it calls routines for the active slots.

name: dispatch_channel_command_alt
description: Decodes the low nibble of a command byte with the same cases as the other dispatch routines: one jumps through a table indexed by a counter, two adjust and clamp a 16-bit value at 113 or 856, one stores a byte, and the rest return.

name: stub_empty_return_routine_b
description: Returns immediately with no work, so it is an empty entry.

name: dispatch_by_counter_table
description: Calls the handler selected from a table by a counter. The jump table could not be recovered, so the target handler is unknown.

name: store_low_nibble_parameter
description: Stores the low four bits of a command byte into a shared cell. The audio and DMA registers listed for this routine are not written by the shown code.

name: start_audio_channel_note
description: Loads the channel's next event from its stream into its record, looks up sample and period values from a table by a nibble, and sets the channel's output words when the event is non-zero.

name: clear_record_table
description: Clears a table of 32 groups of records to zero, setting one field of each group to eight.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][t +10 ATX](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (5632 bytes):0:0130
name: shift_bits_refilling_via_reader
description: Shifts bits out of a register for a count taken from its argument, calling the packed-longword reader whenever the register empties.

name: stub_empty_return_routine_c
description: Returns immediately with no work, so it is an empty entry.

name: compute_bitplane_row_pointers
description: Computes the bitplane address for a row from a nibble and a base value, multiplied by 160 bytes, and stores four pointers spaced 40 bytes apart. It also stores an inverted nibble into a word.

name: init_custom_chips_and_copper
description: Clears the colour registers, sets the copper list pointer and its jump, writes interrupt enable and DMA control values, and configures a CIA port bit. The register list also marks the joystick port and an interrupt request, which the shown writes do not touch.

name: swap_two_longwords_and_call
description: Clears a word, swaps two consecutive longwords, and calls two routines around the swap.

name: service_frame_interrupt
description: Runs per-frame housekeeping: sets status bits from two reads, increments a frame counter, calls an optional callback when one is installed, and dispatches a routine based on the current state.

name: service_frame_interrupt_alt
description: Performs the same per-frame status-bit update, counter increment and optional callback as its neighbour, without the initial reset step.

name: fade_colour_components_per_step
description: On each active step, decrements a timer and, when it runs out, reduces each 4-bit component of the colour entries by the current step, clamped at zero. A second mode subtracts one per component instead.

name: copy_words_into_stride_table
description: Copies a run of 16-bit words from a source into a destination spaced four bytes apart, with the count taken from its argument.

name: setup_colour_fade_state
description: Stores the source and destination pointers and step counts for the colour fade, resets the step counter, and sets the active flag with a count of 15 per entry.

name: get_fade_active_flag
description: Returns the low bit of a status byte, indicating whether the colour fade is active.

name: poll_field_then_return_value
description: Repeatedly tests a field in a block, but the shown loop condition compares the field with itself, so the decompiled loop is unreliable. The routine returns its data register.

name: mix_bits_six_byte_result
description: Mixes the bits of two input words with shifts, masks and exclusive-or operations into a six-byte result. The purpose of the mix is not identifiable from the shown code.

name: compute_sprite_corner_positions
description: Computes two coordinate pairs from a record's position and offsets. When a flag is set it also computes a second pair from four further fields; otherwise it stores a fixed sentinel value.

name: clear_position_when_flag_set
description: When a status bit is set, stores a fixed sentinel value into two position fields, then calls two routines.

name: write_four_byte_pattern_buffers
description: Writes a four-byte pattern into four buffers: a fill value, a value taken from half of an input word, a value offset by eight in two of the buffers, and a fixed flag byte with its low bit set.

name: wait_zero_reset_copper
description: Calls two routines until the second returns zero, then clears a field and writes the copper list pointer and jump registers.

name: advance_wrapping_counter_per_tick
description: Calls a routine and, on a periodic condition derived from a field, increments a counter that wraps back to one after ten.

name: copy_twenty_two_row_block
description: Copies a block of 22 rows of four-longword groups from a source area into a destination, using a stride of 160 bytes for the destination and 352 bytes for the source.

name: cycle_animation_frame_index
description: Returns the current animation frame number. When a delay counter has run out it either resets the frame to zero or advances it, wrapping at six; otherwise it decrements the counter.

name: record_table_value_against_thresholds
description: Checks two status fields, then compares a table value with three stored thresholds and records it in the matching one, calling a routine afterwards.

name: dispatch_or_copy_position_words
description: When a mode field is zero, calls a handler chosen from a table by an index field. Otherwise it copies two position words from one pair of fields to another.

name: copy_two_position_words
description: Copies two 16-bit values from one pair of record fields into another pair.

name: draw_tile_map_cells
description: Walks the grid of tile cells inside a visible window in two passes. For each cell whose value is at least ten it clears the flag bits and calls a handler, selected from a table, with the cell's screen coordinates.

name: reset_timer_and_counters
description: Sets a timer field to 50 and clears two counter fields.

name: step_bcd_countdown_timer
description: When active, advances a tick counter and, when it reaches its threshold, decrements a two-digit BCD value with carry into the second digit. It calls a routine while the value stays below a limit and clears the active state when the value reaches its end.

name: check_bcd_countdown_end
description: Calls a routine while the BCD countdown value is below a limit, and clears the timer state when the value reaches its end value.

name: reset_object_state_fields
description: Calls a routine, then clears three state bytes and several counter fields, sets an active flag to one, and copies a stored value into a timer.

name: find_record_containing_point
description: Walks a table of 144-byte records and returns one for the first record whose stored bounds contain the point given by the arguments offset from the base position, saving its address. It returns zero when no record matches.

name: read_tile_nibble_at_position
description: Converts a position into tile-grid coordinates by shifting them right four bits, then reads the tile byte. It returns the low nibble, or zero when the low five bits of the tile byte exceed nine.

name: allocate_entry_record
description: Finds the first free record in a table of 144-byte entries, stores the given position into it, clears its fields and marks it in use. It returns zero on success and minus one when the table is full.

name: process_active_record_tables
description: Walks three tables of 144-byte records and calls a routine for each record whose low flag bit is set. The last table also toggles two flag bits on records that have the second bit set, and the middle table is skipped under a condition.

name: process_flagged_records_short
description: Walks eight 144-byte records and calls a routine for each one whose low flag bit is set.

name: update_object_position_and_bounds
description: For an active object, removes it when its position leaves the visible bounds, after writing a stored value to its registered address if allowed. Otherwise it advances the position by its velocity, updates timer flags, and calls the object's behaviour routine when its delay expires or steps its animation script otherwise.

name: advance_object_animation_script
description: Advances an object's animation script: when the script has a pending entry it reads the next one, updates the position from the velocity, and sets the frame flags.

name: find_overlapping_target_record
description: Scans a table of 16 enabled records for one whose bounds overlap the probe rectangle, and when a flag is set it stores that record as the current target along with a stored value.

name: find_overlapping_target_record_alt
description: Performs the same overlap scan as its neighbour over a table of eight records, storing the first overlapping record as the current target.

name: collect_overlapping_record
description: Scans eight records for one whose flag bit is set and whose bounds overlap the probe rectangle. On a match it reduces a counter by two, clears the record's flag bit and stores the record as the match.

name: link_overlapping_record_to_object
description: Scans eight records for one that overlaps the object's bounds. On a match it reduces a counter by two, clears the record's flag bit, and links the record and its stored value to the object.

name: resolve_object_pair_collisions
description: For each active record in one table, tests overlap against records in a second table. On overlap it compares a stored value and either calls a handler or redirects both objects' state and adjusts a position field.

name: resolve_collisions_excluding_tagged
description: Tests overlap between active records of two tables in the same way as its neighbour, but skips a pair when the source record carries one of two fixed two-letter tags. On overlap it calls a handler or updates state.

name: trigger_overlapping_records_table
description: Walks 20 records and, for each enabled record whose bounds overlap the probe rectangle, sets its timer field and calls a routine.

name: trigger_first_overlapping_record
description: Walks ten records and, for the first enabled record with a flag bit set whose bounds overlap the probe rectangle, sets its timer and calls a routine before returning.

name: select_overlapping_interaction_record
description: Scans 16 records for an enabled one with a flag bit set whose bounds overlap the probe rectangle. On a match it stores the record's values, sets interaction flags and adjusts a stored offset. When no record matches it clears a flag bit.

name: detect_records_in_window
description: For each of eight records whose position has changed and lies within a window of 768 by 384 units from a reference point, calls a handler with a fixed code and sets a result flag.

name: detect_records_in_window_alt
description: Performs the same window test as its neighbour without the change check, calling a handler with a different fixed code for each record inside the window and setting a result flag.

name: build_display_frame_buffers
description: Clears a block of 1280 longwords, copies groups of record data from four source tables into the buffer, copies 24 rows selected by a stored index, and calls routines depending on state flags.

name: draw_seven_digit_field
description: Calls a set of routines, then reads a stored 32-bit field and calls a routine for each of its seven 4-bit digits, from the most significant, skipping leading zeros.

name: draw_seven_digit_field_alt
description: Uses the same seven-digit loop as its neighbour, with fewer preparatory calls.

name: draw_seven_digit_field_b
description: Uses the same seven-digit loop as its neighbours, with a different set of preparatory calls.

name: sync_object_tables_per_frame
description: Once per frame, copies blocks of the 32-record table selected by an animation index and mode into the active tables when the state changes, then calls routines according to the mode bits.
